name: The Regrainery | Custom Woodworking & Hand-Built Furniture in Portland, OR
old_description: To our friends, family, and all interested parties and clients, past and present:
about:
The Regrainery is a custom furniture shop based in southeast Portland, Oregon, founded in 2016. The business began in a small garage and has grown while maintaining a deliberately small scale, focusing on hand-built pieces for homes and offices.

The shop specializes in custom hardwood dining tables but also produces benches, desks, cabinetry, and a small line of ready-made products. A team of woodworkers with backgrounds ranging from guitar-making to architecture collaborates on each project, handling design, build, and installation. The company intentionally limits its workload so that booked clients receive full attention until completion.

Clients include homeowners and small businesses seeking one-off furniture for residential and office spaces. Past projects documented in testimonials include a walnut dining table, a bathroom vanity, built-in banquette seating with curved details, cabinet and shelving systems, a custom cutting board, a guitar-pick table top, a bookcase-cabinet combination, a wardrobe-dresser for a small apartment, a room divider, and paired walnut tables with a unique leg design.

The Regrainery was started out of a love for the craft of woodworking and a desire to blend high-quality construction with exceptional service. The founders emphasize a highly collaborative process—both within the team and with clients—and a commitment to delivering finished pieces on schedule.

name: The Solar Guys
old_description: Helping Kansas, Missouri, and Iowa families save on energy since 2014.
about:
The Solar Guys was founded in 2014 in Ankeny, Iowa, by brothers Jesse and Jereme. The Iowa-raised, family-owned company began with a mission to make clean energy simple for customers across Kansas, Missouri, and Iowa.

The company designs and installs custom solar energy systems for residential and commercial properties, along with battery backup and service for existing arrays. All work is performed in-house — from site assessment and system engineering through permitting, installation, and ongoing monitoring — without subcontractors. They evaluate roof condition, structure energy-use data, and size each system to the property’s long-term performance. A 25-year workmanship warranty covers every installation.

The Solar Guys serves homeowners and commercial property owners in Kansas, Missouri, and Iowa. Residential clients receive custom rooftop systems sized to actual usage, while commercial projects are engineered for 10-, 20-, and 25-year returns, with assistance navigating tax credits, depreciation, and C-PACE financing. The team also services and repairs systems it did not originally install.

The brothers started the business to offer honest pricing, real-person communication, and installations built to outlast the warranty. Their differentiators include a fully in-house crew, no-subcontractor policy, custom design for every roof and budget, and a commitment to handle all permitting and utility paperwork.

name: The Treehouse Hardwoods & Mill Shop
old_description: Great pieces of miscellaneous Hardwoods for your DIY Projects!
about:
The Treehouse Hardwoods & Mill Shop was established in 1966 in South Burlington, Vermont. The business is operated by a team of woodworkers including Lucas, Carl, Jeremy, Adam, Tim, Sherb, John, and Jude, who together bring nearly 60 years of experience in buying, selling, and working with wood.

The company maintains a large inventory of domestic and exotic hardwoods, live-edge slabs sourced from Vermont, New Hampshire, and New York, hardwood plywood, and specialty items such as burls and "Hard Maple Cookies." Its millshop provides custom milling services including planing up to 24 inches, wide-belt sanding up to 42 inches, resawing up to 16 inches, CNC milling, and reproduction of antique moldings, car parts, and boat parts. The shop also produces butcher-block tops, table and counter tops, stair components, and custom sawn veneer.

Customers range from professional woodworkers and hobbyists to homeowners, builders, and contractors. The millshop handles small-to-medium projects, including new construction, remodeling, and historic building restoration.

The company distinguishes itself by combining a broad retail selection — described as the largest variety of hardwood plywood in northern Vermont — with a job-shop capable of custom reproduction work, all while emphasizing personal advice and service for projects of any skill level.

name: The Wood Shop Iowa
old_description: At The Wood Shop, Inc., our story is rooted in tradition, craftsmanship, and family values. Founded by DeWayne Dykstra, a man with a passion for woodworking and a deep connection to his Dutch heritage, our journey began with a single stall garage in the heart of Orange City, Iowa.
about:
The Wood Shop, Inc. operates from Orange City, Iowa, where it was founded in 1985 by DeWayne Dykstra. A family-owned business rooted in Dutch heritage, it began in a single-stall garage before moving to a dedicated facility in 1993. Dykstra passed ownership to his sons Josh, James, and Jake in 2018, who now lead a team of about 15 craftsmen and project managers.

The company manufactures custom cabinetry, architectural millwork, and fireplaces in its own woodworking shop, using mortise-and-tenon face frames, biscuit-joined construction, and furniture-grade finishes. It also provides full-service residential remodeling—kitchens, bathrooms, additions—and commercial cabinetry for offices, churches, schools, healthcare facilities, and retail spaces. Countertop materials include Cambria Quartz, granite, marble, onyx, solid surface, and laminate. Onyx Collection showers are fabricated and installed on-site.

Primary customers are homeowners across Northwest Iowa, including Orange City, Sioux Center, Le Mars, Okoboji, Sioux City, and surrounding communities. Commercial clients span offices, churches, schools, healthcare providers, and retail businesses throughout Iowa, with reach into South Dakota and Minnesota.

The Wood Shop emphasizes in-house cabinet production for complete quality control, construction techniques designed for 20-year durability, personalized design tailored to each household's use patterns, and a single-team approach that manages projects from design through final walkthrough.

name: The Worden Company
old_description: Founded and based in West Michigan, with relationships that stretch from coast to coast.
about:
Founded in 1949 in Holland, Michigan, The Worden Company began as a woodworking operation and grew into a multi-material fabrication and assembly partner serving clients nationwide.

The company produces custom and production-run furniture, clinical finished goods, and OEM product-complete assemblies. Its integrated capabilities span machining, upholstery, thermoforming, finishing, sewing, PET felt fabrication, wood/laminate/solid surface work, steel and aluminum component machining, multi-substrate finish development, subassembly, final assembly, and kitting. Operations range from hand fabrication to full production volumes.

Worden serves two primary segments: furniture and clinical product OEMs, and library/commercial interior projects. For OEMs it builds seating (lounge chairs, task seating, stools), clinical carts (procedure, treatment, supply carts, mobile workstations, overbed tables), and wood casegoods (conference tables, reception desks, shelving). For architectural projects it delivers custom furniture and architectural elements.

The firm emphasizes a single synchronized flow of product and accountability, replacing multiple supply channels with integrated engineering, supply chain management, continuous improvement, and quality systems certified to ISO 9001:2015 and Architectural Woodwork Institute standards.

name: TheFuseShop
old_description: Glass fuses have a low breaking capacity. It's easy to see when they're blown: the glass will be discolored and the filament broken. Replace yours today!
about:
TheFuseShop operates from Ames, Iowa, as an online retailer specializing in fuses and circuit protection components. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available materials.

The business stocks and sells a broad inventory of glass, ceramic, and automotive fuses, along with fuse holders, blocks, reducers, and circuit breakers. Its catalog spans thousands of part numbers from major manufacturers including Bussmann, Littelfuse, Mersen, SIBA, Fuji, and Daito, as well as circuit breaker lines from Eaton, GE, Siemens, Square D, ABB, and others. The company claims to maintain the largest selection of Bussmann fuses among U.S.-based retailers.

Customers span automotive restoration, electronics repair, industrial maintenance, appliance service, and HVAC fields.

TheFuseShop differentiates itself with free standard shipping on all U.S. orders, a library of how-to guides and video tutorials covering fuse basics and troubleshooting, and a stated focus on breadth of stock for hard-to-find fuse types.

name: Theatrix Hawaii - Audio Visual Company - Maui
old_description: Theatrix Hawaii specializes in event production throughout Hawaii. We have warehouses on Oahu and Maui, but also operate on Kaua'i, the Big Island and Lana'i. We can help make the event you envision a reality.
about:
Theatrix Hawaii was founded in 2001 by Jack Hufstetler in Kahului, Hawaii. The company began as an audio-visual and event production firm serving the Hawaiian Islands, growing from a local operation into a multi-island service provider.

The company provides a full range of event production services including lighting, audio, video, staging, rigging, décor, special effects, CAD design, fabrication, and heavy equipment services. It operates warehouses on Oahu and Maui and extends services to Kauai, the Big Island, and Lanai, handling events from intimate gatherings to arena-sized productions.

Theatrix serves corporate event planners, concert promoters, government and military organizations, non-profits, and healthcare institutions. Past clients include the USO for Toby Keith concerts, the USS Missouri Memorial Association, AFCEA International's TechNet Asia Pacific conference, Multi Image Group, and Hawaii Pacific Health.

The company distinguishes itself as the only firm in Hawaii holding a rigging and electrical contractor's license (C-29606). It emphasizes an experienced technician team, attention to detail, and over two decades of island-wide event experience.

name: ThermOmegaTech Electronics Division
old_description: ThermOmegaTech’s Electronics division specializes in custom PCB assembly for aerospace, defense, and commercial electronics markets.
about:
ThermOmegaTech Electronics Division operates from Warminster, Pennsylvania, as a specialized unit of ThermOmegaTech focused on custom printed circuit board assembly for aerospace, defense, and commercial electronics markets. The division leverages the parent company’s three decades of experience in electronic manufacturing, though a specific founding year for the electronics division is not publicly stated.

The facility provides a full suite of electronic contract manufacturing services, including surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly, rigid and flexible circuit fabrication, multi-layer board production, electro-mechanical assembly, box builds, and cable assembly. It also offers new product introduction (NPI) support, design-for-manufacturability (DFM) consulting, PCB prototyping, and turnkey assembly solutions. A dedicated brand, TemitroniK, produces LED boards up to 2 feet by 5 feet with IoT control integration. Engineering services cover analog, digital, RF, and multilayer PCB design. The Warminster plant is equipped with automated SMART assembly lines capable of short-run to high-volume production.

Customers span aerospace and defense, medical devices, industrial equipment, LED lighting, non-commodity consumer electronics, and telecommunications sectors. The division serves both commercial and defense programs, with certifications supporting work on sensitive government projects.

ThermOmegaTech Electronics differentiates itself through a modern process methodology, real-time communication, and a highly trained team. It holds AS9100D and CMMC Level 2 certifications alongside ISO 9001, ensuring secure, compliant manufacturing for regulated industries. The company emphasizes a one-point-of-contact model, collaborating in-house with its sister mechanical-engineering firm to deliver complete product development from concept to production.

name: Thermoplastics Engineering Corporation
old_description: For over 30 years, Thermoplastics Engineering Corp. has been a trusted provider of custom machine solutions for the wire and cable/fiber optic industries. We specialize in engineering custom machinery for the cable extrusion and wire coating extrusion process.
about:
Thermoplastics Engineering Corporation was established in the summer of 1986 in Leominster, Massachusetts. The company operated independently for over three decades before being acquired in June 2021 by Broomfield, a fourth-generation family-owned winding machine manufacturer based in Bolton, Massachusetts.

The company engineers and builds custom machinery for wire, cable, and fiber optic production. Its product lines include extruders, cablers, respoolers, payoffs, takeups, dancers, accumulators, capstans, control systems, and taping equipment. TEC also serves the plastics market with machinery for tubing, profile, and compounding extrusion. A multidisciplinary staff of mechanics, engineers, electricians, programmers, and machinists supports design, fabrication, and service.

TEC serves manufacturers in the wire and cable, fiber optic, and plastics extrusion sectors. Its equipment is used in the production of insulated wire, fiber optic cable, plastic tubing, profile shapes, and compounded materials. The company provides both complete production lines and individual machines to integrate into existing operations.

TEC differentiates itself by starting with a base machine platform and customizing it to each customer's unique requirements. The company emphasizes its experienced in-house team and its ability to deliver end-to-end solutions for fiber optic cable products, as well as its commitment to building dependable machines for the wire and cable production process.
